translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Imotaa Geeshshatetsaa
Med'inaa Goday Musa hawaadan yaageedda;

«Ta geeshsha suntsaa unttunttu tunissenna mala, Israa'eeliyaa Asay taw dummayeedda imotaa Aarooninne Aa attuma naanay bonchchuwaan akkiide, geeshshatetsaan naagana mala, unttunttoo oda. Taani Med'inaa Godaa.

«Unttunttoo hawaadan yaaga; ‹Sintsanna yiyaa yeletaa ubbaan hintte zariyaappe ooninne tuni uttiide, Israa'eeliyaa Asay Med'inaa Godaw dummayeedda geeshsha yarshshuwaakko shiik'ooppe, he Asay ta sintsaappe bohetto. Taani Med'inaa Godaa.

« ‹Aaroona zariyaappe wolk'k'aama galbbaa harggii de'iyaa, woy bollaappe ayayneekka goggiyaa ooninne geeyana gakkanaw, geeshsha yarshshuwaappe mooppo. Anhaa bochchiide tuneeddawaa woy Aa attumatetsaappe zeretsay gukkeedda uraa bochchiyaa ooninne tuna.
Woy k'ay sa'aanna gooshettiyaa, tunissiyaawantta, woy ay mala tunatetsaa gidooppenne tunissiyaa asaa bochchiyaa uray,
woy hewaa malabaa ayaanne bochchiyaa asay, omarssi gakkanaw I tuna; bare bollaa haatsaan meec'ettennaan de'iidde, he geeshsha yarshshuwaappe I maanaw koshshenna.
Away wulliyaa wode I geeshsha gidee; Hewaappe guyyiyaan, he geeshsha yarshshuwaappe barena gakkiyaawaa mo gaasuukka hewe Aa k'umaa.
Barew hayk'k'eeddawaa woy do'ay wod'eedda mehiyaa ashuwaa mooppo; hewe tunissiyaabaa. Taani Med'inaa Godaa.
« ‹K'eesetuu ta wogaa; naagennan is's'ooppe, unttunttu Aa tunissiide Aa nagaran hayk'k'ana. Unttuntta geeshshiyaawe Taana Med'inaa Godaa.
« ‹He geeshsha yarshshuwaa k'eesiyaa soo asaappe attina, hara Asay mooppo; k'eesiyaa soo yeedda imatsaa gidina, woy k'as's'arettiide ootsiyaa k'oomaa gidinakka mooppo.
Shin k'eesii bare biran shammeedda ayiliyaa woy Aa son yeletteedda ayilii he k'umaappe mo.
K'eesiyaa gidenna hara asaa geleedda k'eesiyaa naatta he geeshsha yarshshuwaappe muuppu.

Shin k'eesiyaa naatta asinay hayk'k'ina, woy asinay yeddina, na'aa yelennaan kase bare wodorotetsaan de'iyaawaadan simmaade bare aawuwaa golle yooppe, Aa bare aawuwaa gakkiyaa k'umaappe mu. Shin hara Asay ooninne hewaappe mooppo.
« ‹Itti Asay erennan de'iidde geeshsha yarshshuwaappe mooppe, he I meedda k'umaa gatiyaa bolla s'eetuwaappe laatamu kushiyaa gujjiide k'eesiyaw immo.
Israa'eeliyaa Asay Med'inaa Godaw yarshshiyaa geeshsha yarshshuwaa k'eesatuu tunissoppino.

Unttunttu barenttu aheedda geeshsha yarshshuwaa barew miide, barenttu nagaran ooshettanaadan, k'eesatuu ootsanaw koshshenna. Ayaw gooppe, unttuntta geeshshiyaawe, taani Med'inaa Godaa yaaga› » yaageedda.
Aketena Yarshshotuwaa
Med'inaa Goday Musa hawaadan yaageedda,

«Aaroonaw, Aa naanatoonne Israa'eeliyaa asaa ubbaw hawaadan yaagaade oda; ‹Israa'eeliyaa asaappe gidina woy unttunttu giddon de'iyaa betiyaappe ooninne Med'inaa Godaw s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa bare dosuwaan c'oo immiyaa woy bare shiik'k'owaa gatsanaw yarshshiyaa wode,
he yarshshuu akettana mala, korumaappe woy dorssaappe woy deeshshaappe tilla bollaanna de'iyaa attumawaa gido.
Bollay tilla gidennawe ayaa gidooppenne aketena diraw, hewaa shiishshoppa.

« ‹K'ay oona gidooppenne bare shiik'k'owaa gatsanaw ittippetetsaa yarshshuwaa S'oossaw yarshshiyaa wode, woy bare mehiyaappe bare dosuwaan c'oo immiyaa imotaa Med'inaa Godaw shiishshiyaa wode, hewe aketana mala I tilla bollaanna de'iyaawaa gido.

Hintte mehiyaappe k'ook'iyaa, woy me'uwaa, woy gunddaa, woy giiyiyaa maytsay, woy puussuu, woy ilahuu de'iyaawaa Med'inaa Godaw yarshshoppite; k'ay taman s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiidekka yarshshiyaa sa'aa bollan Med'inaa Godaw shiishshoppite.
Aa bollan pac'a med'etay woy pac'abay de'iyaa korumaa woy dorssaa itti Asay bare dosuwaan c'oo immiyaa yarshshoo shiishshanaw danddayee; shin shiik'uu gatso gidooppe, hewe aketena.
Sanggisetteeddawaa woy k'os'etteeddawaa woy kaatsay maytteeddawaa woy k'ans's'etteeddawaa Med'inaa Godaw yarshshoppite. Hintte gadiyaan hewaa malabaa ootsoppite.

Hintte giddon de'iyaa allaga asatuwaappe akkeedda hewaa mala mehiyaakka hintte S'oossaw k'uma ootsiide shiishshoppite. Unttunttu bollay tilla gidennawaa gaasuwaan unttunttun pokkuu de'iyaa diraw, unttunttu hintte diraw akettikino› yaaga» yaageedda.
K'aykka Med'inaa Goday Musa hawaadan yaageedda,

«Miizzaa maray woy dorssaa maray woy deeshshaa maray yelettiyaa wode, laappun gallassaa bare daayinna gam"o. Hosppuntsa gallassaappe doommiide, Med'inaa Godaw taman s'uugiide shiishshiyaa yarshsho ootsiide shiishshanaw danddayettee.
Miyatoo, dorssatoo, woy deeshshatoo I maraanna itti gallassi shukkoppite.
«Hintte galataa yarshshuwaa Med'inaa Godaw shiishshiyaa wode, hintte yarshshuu aketanaadan yarshshite.
He yarshshuu he gallassikka meetettanaw koshshee; aappe ayaanne wonttiw ashshoppite. Taani Med'inaa Godaa.
«Ta azazuwaa naagitenne ootsite. Taani Med'inaa Godaa.
K'ay ta geeshsha suntsaa hintte tunissoppite; Israa'eeliyaa asaa giddon taani geeshsha gidiyaawe erettanaw bessee. Hinttena geeshshiyaawe, taani Med'inaa Godaa.
Hinttew S'oossaa gidanaw, hinttena Gibs'e gadiyaappe kesseeddawe taana. Taani Med'inaa Godaa» yaageedda.
